title: GFG: Intersection of Two Arrays
description: Given two arrays `a` and `b`, return the intersection of the two arrays as a sorted list of distinct common elements.
constraints:
0 <= len(a), len(b) <= 10^5
• Time: O((N + M) log(N + M)) | Space: O(N + M)
starter_code:
def intersection_arrays(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def intersection_arrays(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    return sorted(list(set(a) & set(b)))
explanation: Set intersection finds common elements, sorted in O((N+M) log(N+M)) time.
